title: ilex montana var. mollis
intro: Ilex montana var. mollis, commonly known as Mollis Holly, is a plant species within the Ilex genus, characterized by its glossy, dark green leaves and red berries. The plant is used in traditional medicine for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which may help alleviate symptoms of colds, flu, and digestive issues. The therapeutic actions of Mollis Holly include stimulating the immune system, reducing fever, and exerting antimicrobial effects. The plant's bioactive constituents, which contribute to its therapeutic properties, include flavonoids, alkaloids, and saponins, although further research is needed to fully understand its effects.
